QUOTE: ret & 0xFF80 → mbedtls_high_level_strerr(ret) ... ret & ~0xFF80 → mbedtls_low_level_strerr(ret) ... join: "HIGH : LOW" (or just one part if the other is zero)
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the code is split into a high-level part and a low-level part, each looked up separately, and that `mbedtls_strerror` joins them as "HIGH : LOW" when both are present.
